items.review_rationale: Read faithfully flat ring maps by restriction of scalars along a unital homomorphism R→S and application of the faithfully flat module criterion to S as an R-module.

references.phrase: R-module structure on S via R→S
references.context: Define scalar multiplication r·s=φ(r)s for φ:R→S; the property is evaluated with this specific action.

references.disposition: Transfers the module property to the codomain through restriction of scalars; not a property of S absent a specified ring map.

items.review_rationale: Read flatness of an R-module M in terms of exactness preservation under tensoring, retaining the R-module category and distinguished one-sided tensor functor.

references.context: Assigns N↦N⊗_R M and transports all module homomorphisms by tensoring with M.

references.phrase: preservation of exactness by tensor functor
references.context: Every exact R-module sequence remains exact after applying −⊗_R M, in particular preserving injections and kernels.

references.phrase: flatness does not assert reflection of exactness
references.disposition: Faithful flatness is the strictly stronger criterion; this formulation requires preservation only.
